title: Separate project implementations from workspace main
objective: Clean the repository without losing work: identify and preserve the newest canonical state of every real project, move each project onto a dedicated long-lived project branch, make main coordination-only, protect active pull requests and historical recovery paths, and document unambiguous branching rules for future agents.
acceptance_criteria: Every real project has a documented canonical source chosen from actual tree identity and ancestry rather than branch-name recency.
No canonical project state is older than a known verified or active newer implementation state.
A pre-cleanup backup reference preserves the complete previous main tree before project removal.
Main contains coordination/workspace code and documentation but no ordinary project implementation trees.
Each normal project has a dedicated long-lived project branch containing only its own canonical project implementation plus required project-specific workspace integration.
Active pull requests are not force-pushed, overwritten, or made dependent on the cleaned main unexpectedly.
Future agents have explicit rules for workspace branches, project base branches, feature branches, stacked branches, and source-of-truth coordination state.
Temporary and duplicate branches are only removed when they are proven redundant and contain no unique canonical project state or active pull request work.
Workspace tests and validation pass after the migration.
